entries.name: Yamama Tower — Metro / Coffee Wizard frontage
entries.source: original authored geometry and original generated canvas artwork; reference photographs are not bundled
entries.heightSource: Retained inferred map massing (26.4 m), not a measured height. Six full residential tiers and a cropped upper tier are visible; the photograph does not establish total floor count or roof height.
limitations: The photograph crops the roof and uppermost extent; massing height and upper closeout remain inferred.
Capture dates and present-day condition are unknown.
The block and north frontage are strongly supported; exact limits of shared retail fascias across neighboring footprints are not measured.
Perspective-derived bay widths, balcony depths, floor spacing, materials and weathering are estimates.
Rear, side elevations, concealed spaces, exact AC and cable positions, and fine signage glyphs lack complete coverage.
Procedural palms and furniture are omitted from the observed frontage strip; actual street-furniture coverage remains incomplete.
